'''David Albós Cavaliere''' (born 7 March 1984) is an [[Andorra]]n former professional [[road racing cyclist]]. He competed with CJAM-CKT-Novatec in 2011,<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.diariociclista.webcindario.com/codigo34.pdf|title=CJAM-CKT-Novatec Team Roster|date=1 September 2011|access-date=6 July 2013|work=CJAM-CKT-Novatec|location=[[Girona]], [[Catalonia]], [[Spain]]}}</ref> and also with the [[national team]], Agrupació Ciclista Andorrana.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.bikeaca.com/Equip|title=Agrupació Ciclista Andorrana Team Roster|date=1 September 2013|access-date=6 July 2013|work=Agrupació Ciclista Andorrana|location=[[Andorra la Vella]], [[Andorra]]|archive-date=13 July 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130713084848/http://www.bikeaca.com/Equip|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Albós competed in the [[2011 UCI Road World Championships – Men's time trial|2011]], the [[2012 UCI Road World Championships – Men's time trial|2012]], the [[2013 UCI Road World Championships – Men's time trial|2013]], and the [[2015 UCI Road World Championships – Men's time trial|2015]] UCI World Time Trial Championships. Albós won the National Time Trial Championships a record seven times. Originally a skier, Albós began competitive cycling in 2008. His brothers [[Ludovic Albós Cavaliere]] and Joan Albós Cavaliere are [[ski mountaineer]]s.
